parents.description: Hashes of the parent commits. Empty for the first commit, two or more for a merge.

authorName.description: Name of the author, after the file .mailmap is applied.

authorEmail.description: Email of the author, after the file .mailmap is applied.

committerName.description: Name of the committer, after the file .mailmap is applied.

committerEmail.description: Email of the committer, after the file .mailmap is applied.

body.description: The rest of the message, without the empty lines at the end.

filesChanged.description: Files that the commit changes. For a merge: the files that the merge brings in, compared with the first parent.

insertions.description: Added lines. A binary file counts 0.

deletions.description: Deleted lines. A binary file counts 0.
